title: Đề luyện Viết VSTEP — Recall RV0821

questions.content:
writing — Task 1

Your friend has heard that you won two tickets to a concert and has written to ask you about it. Write a letter to your friend. In your letter, you should: 1. tell your friend where and when the concert is and who will be performing 2. explain how you managed to get the two tickets 3. suggest how your friend could get tickets too

writing — Task 2

You should spend about 60 minutes on this task. These days, more and more people manage their money through online banking and pay for things by scanning QR codes with their phones. Supporters say these services are fast and convenient, while others worry about the dangers they may bring. What are the benefits and the potential risks of online banking and QR-code payments? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write an essay of at least 250 words.
